findings.text: Both spawn-guard cases assert only `pid > 0` (here and at :461), which cannot fail for any successful return of _supervisor_spawn_worker; the discriminating signal is the absence of the _reservation_refusal raise. The cases do redden on the regression, as logs/repair-4-controls.log shows, but the assertion itself guards nothing.

The fresh-run case's `assert not list(directory.glob('attempt-*.reservation'))` is not independent of the guard it claims to cover: its _dispatch helper passes a caller-supplied launcher, so reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3551 releases any reservation the launch took, and the assertion would still pass if the run_holds_an_attempt_record guard at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2861 were removed entirely.

paired dispatch pre-creates both arms' run directories, so the shadow arm's first launch finds attempt.json written at :2772, takes a reservation at :2863, and has its attempt overwritten by the key from its own empty directory, discarding the attempt it derived from the primary line; the section requires a first launch under a fresh run id to take no reservation and keep that attempt.

_supervisor_write refuses to create the run directory, and an ordinary fresh launch creates it only at :2894, so the attempt marker this block exists to write is silently dropped for exactly the case its comment describes (a launcher that ends before writing anything); it lands only for relaunches, which already hold attempt receipts.

claim_next_attempt and release_attempt_claim at :358 lost their last production caller when the resume door moved to reserve_launch_attempt, leaving a second attempt-claiming mechanism in the module that only tests exercise.

the supervisor record is written under contextlib.suppress(OSError), so a failed write leaves the reservation naming the reserving process; on the admit service, which outlives every run it launches, that keeps the run unlaunchable for as long as the service lives with no record of why.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_concurrent_launch_is_refused.py:284 reddens if a reservation were freed by age and :307 if it were freed by the pointer, but :446 and :461 assert only pid > 0 and :782 passes whenever the caller-launcher seam at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3551 releases the reservation, so it would survive removal of the guard it claims to cover.
justifications.evidence: logs/merge-gate-head.log records 28 passed EXIT=0 at 610b4dc129 and logs/repair-5-base.log records 19 failed, 9 passed EXIT=1 at 29b47d2cb8, both carried as baseline_suite and after_suite with revisions, literal commands and log paths; logs/repair-4-controls.log and logs/repair-3-controls.log show each declared mutation reddening the case it names.
justifications.fit: The new block follows the module's own idiom (a frozen dataclass, a pattern constant, a documented refusal) at reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2150 and adds no plan, sprint or ticket identifier, and ruff check adds no finding on the staged paths, but reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py:2440 swallows the supervisor-record write so a failed record leaves the reservation naming the door for as long as it lives.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The reservation is taken before _create_worktree at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:2861 and released by the supervisor's own exit at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:3536, and every door in the section's list has a case in tests/test_a_concurrent_launch_is_refused.py, but a paired dispatch pre-creates both run directories at reckon/crew/dispatch.py:1351 so its first launch takes a reservation the section says a fresh run must not, and the early attempt marker at :2772 is a silent no-op for an ordinary fresh launch whose directory appears only at :2894.
justifications.reuse: launch_reservation_key and reserve_launch_attempt are a second attempt-claiming mechanism beside claim_next_attempt at reckon/crew/resumption.py:389, which the section's measured constraints justify not reusing, but the superseded owner is left in place with no production caller and is now exercised only by tests.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 29b47d2cb8..06f62cb6db lists only the four declared modules, the new test, the extended tests/test_a_resume_never_launches_beside_another_node.py and the evidence fragment; the 149 files in 610b4dc129 are the merge of primary main, not authored changes.
